description: This file defines the IHealthCheckable interface in the Orleans.Runtime namespace, which declares a method for probing the health status of services implementing this interface.

classes.name: IHealthCheckable
classes.description: An interface for services that can be checked for health status; contains a method CheckHealth for performing health probes.

methods.name: CheckHealth
methods.description: A method that returns a boolean indicating health status and an output string 'reason' explaining the verdict.
